decision.topic: tenancy physical storage and isolation strategy
decision.note: The approved option fixes the tenancy topology as a governance selection. It is not a schema, a policy, a migration or an enforcement: nothing is applied to any database, and the substrate work stays KGA-D06.

immutableRefs.note: Approval intake, EPOCH-03 chain, registry, gap addendum, the tenancy authority inventory and ADR-0026 are read by digest only; application state lives in the application-state ledger.

invariants: The approved topology is a governance selection only: shared schema keyed by tenant_id, recorded PLANNING_ONLY, VALID_BLOCKED and gated NO_GO.
Mandatory PostgreSQL RLS deny-by-default survives the selection unchanged: FORCE RLS stays required and denyByDefault stays true; a shared schema never relaxes isolation.
Selecting a topology is not enforcing it: runtimeEnforcement, schemaApplied, policyApplied and migrationApplied all stay false and the executor stays human-developer-only.
Enforcement is deferred to the KGA-D06 substrate decision; no schema, policy, migration or RLS statement is written, generated or scheduled here.
The topology is fixed, so there is no tenant-count threshold and no automatic promotion to schema-per-tenant or hybrid.
The tenancy authority inventory stays byte-identical read-only evidence with physicalStrategy null and threshold null: this record carries the selection, the inventory never gains one.
ADR-0026 remains a frontend tech-profile document and is still not the tenancy authority.
The registry keeps all ten decisions pending and unselected; the closure intake and EPOCH-03 chain are read by digest only.
No planning artifact here is runtime implementation evidence, a code-start permit or a readiness claim.
nonGoals: do not write, generate or apply any schema, RLS policy, migration, seed or database object for the selected topology
do not claim runtime tenant isolation, enforcement or verification from a recorded selection
do not set a tenant-count threshold or allow automatic promotion to another physical strategy
do not weaken mandatory RLS deny-by-default, change tenant_id as the tenant key, or re-open the topology without a new human decision
do not mutate the tenancy authority inventory, the generated nodes, the generator, the base queue, any registry decision or the closure intake
do not treat ADR-0026 as tenancy authority, and do not write runtime, platform or kernel product code

rollback.trigger: the selected topology, tenant key or RLS floor drifts, an enforcement flag flips to applied, a threshold or automatic promotion appears, the tenancy inventory bytes or its null strategy change, or a fail-closed gate flag flips
rollback.action: revert this selection record, its application-state row, the attestation contract, tests, pack sections and gate wiring as one shard
